# Marked 17.0.5

`marked.esm.js` is the unmodified ESM distribution from the preinstalled npm package `marked@17.0.5`. License: MIT (`marked-LICENSE.md`). Upstream: https://github.com/markedjs/marked

Model HTML and image tokens are escaped or replaced before parsing. Parsed output is rebuilt using an element allowlist in `platform/safe-markdown.js`; only validated HTTP, HTTPS and mailto links receive href attributes.
